import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Feature columns (exclude 'Id' and 'Cover_Type')
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].values - 1  # convert to 0-indexed
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Split for validation (10% holdout)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# LightGBM parameters optimized for speed and accuracy
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": 7,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Validation prediction and accuracy
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)

# Test prediction and submission
test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1) + 1  # convert back to 1-indexed

# Create submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred_classes})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print evaluation metric
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")
